description: This file contains unit tests for the silo role-based placement strategy in Orleans, specifically testing placement failures when roles are missing and successful placement on specified roles.

classes.name: SiloRoleBasedPlacementDirectorTests
classes.description: Unit test class for testing silo role-based placement logic in Orleans, verifying both failure and success scenarios.

methods.name: SiloRoleBasedPlacementDirector_CantFindSilo
methods.description: Tests that attempting to place a grain on a non-existent silo role results in an OrleansException.

methods.name: SiloRoleBasedPlacementDirector_CanFindSilo
methods.description: Tests that a grain can be successfully placed on a silo with a specific role.
